During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a high-ranking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] '''officer''' was under the protection of [[Shroud Team]] in [[Corint City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pirik]]. [[Thilis-Brin]], an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] member of the team, ensured the officer's safety by evading [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] in a high-speed [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] pursuit through the [[Talamp Industrial Sector]]. Thilis-Brin successfully delivered the officer to the required destination while avoiding being identified.
